description: On the pink bed sheet in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case and a white charging cable lying nearby against a plain fabric backdrop. The left hand guides the cable tip toward the AirPods case while the right hand slides in from the right to steady the case; the right hand then lifts and angles the case as the left hand inserts the connector, making the AirPods case a two-hand object during the plug-in before both hands settle with the case held near the bed surface.
